evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~436-443 °C, physically implausible versus all column temperatures 63-76 °C, and drifts slowly upward
Slow oscillating temperature waves along the column with no corresponding reflux/distillate response
Reflux and distillate both near zero (0-2 L/h) yet FYI702 reports a steady ratio ~6-7, inconsistent with measured flows
